move.instructions: Which move should the snake make next? Never move into a wall (#) or into the snake's own body (s). Among safe moves, prefer the one that gets closer to the food (F).

criteria.up: move the head one row up
criteria.down: move the head one row down
criteria.left: move the head one column left
criteria.right: move the head one column right
